text: And then it was all over...

method.measurement: Backward optical flow and smooth multiplicative shading measured separately for each RGB channel in every original frame; a four-pixel numerical grid transfers that effect to English outlines.
method.rendering: Native Canvas in the bundled NW.js browser samples the English glyph mask using the measured flow and gain. FFmpeg encodes the rendered frames as a normal GIF. Python only analyzes original pixels; it does not edit or render animation images.
method.normal_build: Verify and package the checked English GIF; OpenCV and the native renderer are only needed to regenerate it.
method.metric_scope: Registration fit against the original Japanese UI images, not an exact-match claim for the English clip. The effect is estimated from images rather than the unavailable original animation project.
